ops.body:
**Root cause found, and it is not load.** This chain's budgets are mutually inconsistent at daemonkit's own defaults: `wire.defaultPeerVerifyTimeout` budgets 2s for a peer verification whose settlement reserve alone is 2.5s (proc) / 3.0s (worker, correctly derived). A trivial verifier run measures 1.78–2.69s against that 2s ceiling — the margin is negative before any load is applied. Load only decides which side of a coin-flip margin a given run lands on, which is why this reproduced on both hosted OSes, across three different tests, and on two of three clean pushes.

It works today only because `worker.totalReserve` under-reserves at 1.5s against proc's real 2.5s. Correcting that alone makes every protected-role handshake fail pre-spawn with `ErrBudgetTooSmall`, so the fix is not local to this flake.

Superseded by `4da2f2f5` (Phase 2: collapse the five handshake budgets to one derived deadline), designed in doc `ce34cd6b`. Close this out when that lands — the flake is a symptom of the restated-budget chain, not a defect of its own.
